## Notes

Slavic Magic (Greg Styczen), Hooded Horse; Windows early access 2024-04-26, still early access with Major Update 8 in August 2026; curved roads and gridless housing; six tax types, yearly King's tax, tithes; soil exhaustion and deforestation; retinue, mercenaries, armed villagers; bandits; AI lords; over 4 million copies by August 2026.
